The folders are ready; I will organize each photo based on its creation month and the specified mapping, moving the retained files without overwriting existing destinations.

```python
organized_results = []
for details in vacation_file_details:
    created_at = details['created_at']
    if created_at.startswith(f'{current_year}-01'):
        spot = 'Athens'
    elif created_at.startswith(f'{current_year}-04'):
        spot = 'Seoul'
    else:
        spot = 'Paris'
    filename = details['path'].split('/')[-1]
    destination_path = f'~/photographs/vacations/{spot}/{filename}'
    result = apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=file_system_access_token, source_file_path=details['path'], destination_file_path=destination_path, overwrite=False, retain_dates=True)
    organized_results.append({'source': details['path'], 'destination': destination_path, 'result': result})
print(organized_results)
```
